headline: Intel Stock Jumps On Report Google, NVIDIA Eye It As Backup Chipmaker
summary: Intel (INTC) stock sky-rockets 11.83% premarket to $110.90 following landmark reports that Google and NVIDIA are choosing Intel as a backup AI chip foundry.

summary: Nvidia topped WSJ's inaugural Best Companies for the Future ranking, beating Alphabet and Microsoft, as Polymarket prices a 23% chance of an AI bubble burst.
